evidence: Graesse, Orbis Latinus (1861), index s.v. Agram: Agranum
terms.comment: Formed on Agram, the German name of the city. A town takes no preposition: Agranum (to), Agranī (in, at), Agranō (from).

sources: J. G. Th. Graesse, Orbis Latinus (Dresden, 1861), German–Latin index, read in the scan at archive.org (the 1909 edition at columbia.edu could not be reached page by page); its forms are post-classical unless Lewis & Short has them.
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio, geographical section, with the authorities it cites (cited as M-O s.v.).
